verdict.rationale: The evidence shows code review in GitHub: you can review a diff before creating a pull request (github-docs-26), and Copilot can review code and suggest changes you apply in a few clicks (github-docs-25, github-docs-9). Nothing describes handling large diffs or showing third-party code quality reports in the review screen; Marketplace apps (github-docs-22) only imply such integrations might exist. Missing for 10: evidence of large-diff review handling, evidence that third-party quality reports appear inline in the PR review screen, independent or hands-on corroboration.
